verdict: MercadoLibre grew revenue 49% to $8.8B as Mercado Pago processed $87B of payments and the credit book jumped 87% to $14.6B — but the cost of that credit growth, a $1.24B bad-debt provision, held operating profit to $611M and net income fell 16% to $417M.

kpis.label: Revenue growth
kpis.note: Net revenues & financial income of $8.8B vs $5.9B in Q1 2025, in dollars; up 46% ignoring currency moves

kpis.label: EPS (GAAP diluted)
kpis.note: Diluted earnings per share, vs $9.74 a year ago; net income was $417M

kpis.label: Gross merchandise volume
kpis.note: The total value of goods sold on the marketplace (GMV), up 42% in dollars

kpis.label: Total payment volume
kpis.note: The total value of payments processed by Mercado Pago (TPV), up 50% in dollars

segments.name: Commerce
segments.note: Marketplace fees, shipping, first-party product sales, advertising and MELI+ subscriptions. Brazil alone brought in $4.8B of total company revenue.

segments.name: Fintech
segments.note: Mercado Pago payment fees, financing fees and interest earned on consumer and merchant credit, plus point-of-sale devices. The credit portfolio reached $14.6B, up 87% YoY.

opex.name: Product and technology development
opex.note: Building and running the marketplace, payments platform and AI tools.

opex.name: Sales and marketing
opex.note: Advertising and customer acquisition across Latin America.

opex.name: Provision for doubtful accounts
opex.note: Money set aside for loans and credit-card balances that may not be repaid, as the credit book grows — it more than doubled YoY.

takeaways.title: Growth re-accelerated
takeaways.text: Revenue grew 49% in dollars — 84 million unique buyers bought 722 million items, and Mercado Pago's monthly active users reached 83 million.

takeaways.title: Margin is a choice, for now
takeaways.text: Operating margin fell to 6.9% from 12.9% a year ago. Two-thirds of the squeeze is the bad-debt provision growing with the credit book; the rest is deliberate spending on shipping and logistics.

takeaways.title: The credit book is ballooning
takeaways.text: The loan and credit-card portfolio grew 87% YoY to $14.6B, its largest-ever quarterly increase; credit cards alone more than doubled to $6.6B. The bad-debt provision — $1.24B this quarter — grows with it.

otherDetail: Below operating income, $27M of interest income and other financial gains and a $6M currency gain were outweighed by $65M of interest expense and other financial losses, for a net other expense of $32M.
footerNote: MercadoLibre reports 'net revenues and financial income' — marketplace sales plus Mercado Pago's financial income; its cost line includes financial expenses.
